title: Not even Sam Altman is safe from AI deepfakes on Instagram
slides: Sam Altman is now a deepfake target on Instagram?
AI-generated scam ads use his face to promote fake giveaways
The fakes are nearly indistinguishable, even to tech-savvy users
Verify every celebrity promotion before clicking or sharing
Next time Altman trends, check the source first
thread_text:
1. Altman's face, fake ads

Scam Instagram ads are using Sam Altman's likeness to push bogus giveaways, and they're spreading fast.

2. Nearly indistinguishable fakes

Even tech-savvy users are struggling to tell these AI-generated ads from real ones, which makes the scam far more dangerous.

3. Trust erosion

When anyone can be faked convincingly, celebrity endorsements lose all credibility online.

4. The click trap

One wrong click on a fake ad can lead to malware or stolen data before you even realize what happened.

5. Check the source

Before you share the next viral Altman ad, verify the account and the offer. If it looks too good, it's fake.
